summary: Set up an external database by connecting as superuser (`psql -h <hostname> -U superuser -p 5432 -d postgres`), creating a user, database and password with the `createDB` or administrator role, then running the installer and checking you can connect with the inventory credentials.
questions: How do I create the database for AAP on an external PostgreSQL?
What role does the AAP database user need?
Does the AAP database user need createDB?
psql connect as superuser to create AAP database
